cases.topic: A star matches one filename segment.
A pattern without a slash matches a basename at any depth.
A pattern containing a slash matches the path relative to its config file.
A star does not consume a path separator.
A question mark consumes one non-separator character.
A character range matches a member of the range.
A negated character class rejects listed characters.
Comma-separated brace alternatives select one suffix.
An ascending numeric brace range includes interior integers.
A globstar directory component may consume zero directories.
A globstar directory component may consume many directories.
A backslash escapes a glob metacharacter.
cases.known_ec4j_difference: ec4j 1.2.0 does not treat an escaped opening brace as a literal in this matcher path.

cases.topic: Whitespace around a key, equals sign, and value is ignored.
The later pair in one section takes precedence.

cases.topic: A later matching section in one file takes precedence.
A configuration file closer to the target takes precedence.
The unset value removes a property inherited from a parent file.
root=true in a nested file prevents inheritance from its parent.
Unknown properties participate in resolution without rejection.
Property names and standard values are ASCII case-insensitive.
A UTF-8 BOM at the beginning of the file is ignored.
Hash and semicolon full-line comments are ignored.
EditorConfig 0.17.2 does not define inline comments; semicolon text remains in the value.

cases.topic: EditorConfig 0.17.2 uses equals as the property separator.
cases.known_ec4j_difference: ec4j 1.2.0 also accepts a colon separator.

cases.topic: Only an ascending num1..num2 pair forms the specified integer range.
Zero is an integer inside an ascending range that contains it.
cases.known_ec4j_difference: ec4j 1.2.0 rejects a numeric-range capture whose text starts with zero, including zero itself.

cases.topic: Integer ranges may contain negative endpoints and values.
cases.known_ec4j_difference: ec4j 1.2.0 compiles numeric-range candidates with an unsigned digit capture.

cases.topic: An empty value is a valid value in the live 0.17.2 specification text.
The 0.17.2 spelling_language property is resolved like other properties.
